description: It’s hard to believe it has been nearly four months since we adjourned the 2020 session, early for the first time since the Civil War. In that brief time, we’ve held our first mostly mail-in election, with lessons learned in preparation for November. We have seen more than 125,000 deaths nationwide
title: What We Do In This Moment Defines Who We Are — Heather Bagnall - Maryland State Delegate - District 33
